name: documentation-strategy
description: Design a documentation strategy: audience map (end-users / API consumers / operators / future maintainers / newcomers / leadership), Diátaxis framework (tutorials / how-to guides / reference / explanation), information architecture for docs, living-documentation + docs-as-code, review + maintenance process with owners + staleness alerts, findability + navigation + search, localization + accessibility, metrics (views / helpfulness / staleness / support deflection). Distinct from tooling selection.
